CodeInjector.PageIntro: Inject HTML, CSS or JavaScript into every page of the Matomo interface, for every user. Only super users can edit this code.
CodeInjector.BodyTopTitle: Code at the top of the body tag
CodeInjector.BodyTopDescription: Injected right after the opening body tag of every Matomo page, before the page content. Wrap your code in script or style tags.
CodeInjector.BodyBottomTitle: Code at the bottom of the body tag
CodeInjector.BodyBottomDescription: Injected right before the closing body tag of every Matomo page, after the page content. Wrap your code in script or style tags.
CodeInjector.SafeModeNotice: The code is not injected on this page, so a snippet breaking the interface can always be fixed here.
CodeInjector.CssSyntaxError: CSS syntax error near %1$s (missing or extra brace, colon or semicolon?)
CodeInjector.HtmlSyntaxError: HTML syntax error near %1$s (invalid or mismatched tag?)
CodeInjector.UnclosedScriptTag: This script tag is never closed, it would swallow the rest of the Matomo page.
CodeInjector.UnclosedStyleTag: This style tag is never closed, it would hide the rest of the Matomo page.
CodeInjector.MissingTags: This code is not wrapped in a script or style tag, it will be displayed as text in every page.
